correctness.rationale: Conditioning on independent copy/refresh ancestry exposes each lag agreement as a constant plus one degree-two monomial in independent centered Rademacher refresh sources. Distinct unordered source pairs are orthogonal; each both-refreshed observation pair contributes a unique positive-square coefficient, yielding a conditional variance floor and unconditional ε²L/4. The proof handles finite ancestry on infinite locally finite graphs. The published variance dichotomy and conditional CLT have exactly their required hypotheses verified. Reproducible exact finite checker passed 2084 tests; these do not replace the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Resolves the primary paper’s explicit question whether the unmodified repetition-count variance may be sublinear, uniformly for every graph and lag. Excludes its logarithmic alternative and supplies a nondegenerate normal limit previously requiring a thinning modification or an unverified lower-variance premise. The finite-time constant is quantitative and geometry-independent, providing a useful structural insight beyond a special graph calculation.
